newsitem.title: USA: FORT JAMES, FORT HOWARD COMPLETE MERGER.
newsitem.headline: FORT JAMES, FORT HOWARD COMPLETE MERGER.

text.p: Fort James Corp, the newly-combined entity of the merger between James River Corp and Fort Howard Corp, said Wednesday it completed the merger and will start trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "FJ" on Thursday.
Fort Howard shareholders, which together with James River shareholders approved the deal Tuesday, received 1.375 James River shares for each share they held.
Former James River chairman Miles Marsh is chairman and chief executive of the new entity, while former Fort Howard chairman Michael Riordan is president and chief operating officer.

A Fort James spokesman said in an interview earlier this week James River's vice president of strategy Ernst Haberly became the combined entity's chief financial officer, replacing Stephen Hare, who left James River earlier this year.

Fort James said it designated a building currently under construction in Deerfield, Ill., to become the comapny's headquarters. It added about 250 employees will move to the building starting early 1998.
